description: This file defines tools for storing and retrieving versioned key-value pairs in AWS DynamoDB, including classes for the tools and methods for loading DynamoDB tables.

classes.name: DynamoDBStoreTool
classes.description: Tool for storing key-value pairs in DynamoDB with versioning

classes.name: DynamoDBRetrieveTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving key-value pairs from DynamoDB with version control

classes.name: AWSDynamoDBKVStorage_Tools
classes.description: Node implementation for AWS DynamoDB KV Storage tools

methods.name: createDynamoDBClient
methods.description: Creates a DynamoDB client with provided credentials and region

methods.name: buildFullKey
methods.description: Builds a full key string with optional prefix and validates length

methods.description: Validates that the key is a non-empty string
